windows.name: main
windows.role: per-group materialize step; the node-side claim of this item

windows.name: factory
windows.role: 15-byte bit-packing leaf used by the init phase; referenced, not a node-side claim on its own

main_semantics.args: output record pointer, group entry pointer, allocator owner pointer (third argument, at the caller's obj+0x1a0)
main_semantics.count: signed 64-bit value of the byte span (group end minus group begin, wrapping) arithmetic-shifted right by 3
main_semantics.output_record: count stored at +0x00 before the allocator call; allocator result stored at +0x08 after the init phase; fields past +0x08 are not written here
main_semantics.bulk_allocation: allocator called once with size count * 80 mod 2**64 and trailing arguments 0, 0
main_semantics.span_limit: byte span (unsigned) strictly greater than 0xcccccccccccccc8 throws bad_array_new_length, after the bulk allocator call

init_phase.iterations: exactly count, skipped when count is 0

slot_fields.+0x08: factory leaf result for (0, 0), which is 0

init_phase.observable: the init pattern is fully overwritten by the fill phase when count > 0, so it appears only in the call log (one factory call per slot)

fill_phase.entry: skipped entirely when the byte span is 0
fill_phase.loop_form: do-while: at least one iteration when the span is nonzero, so a 1..7-byte span materializes exactly one element; afterwards index advances while index < count (unsigned)

per_element.allocator_call: size is the sum of the two segment lengths mod 2**64; trailing arguments are the previous element pointer (0 on the first fill call) and 0
per_element.copies: first segment bytes then second segment bytes into the fresh buffer, in order

slot_fields.+0x40: concatenation buffer pointer plus first segment length

per_element.group_entry_fields: only the begin and end pointers; the third qword (+0x10) is never read

callers.0x5f8029a: inside the pipeline group pass 0x5f801f0 (pinned by the earlier RE-001 pipeline item; that item records this call, this item models the callee)
callers.0x5da98b8: inside the 5417-byte function 0x5da8870..0x5da9d99; recorded site-only, its surrounding logic is not claimed

factory_semantics.call_site_use: called with (0, 0) once per init slot, so the stored value is always 0; the general form is recorded because the leaf is only 15 bytes and fully read

assumptions: The caller supplies at least as many elements as the fill phase reads; a shorter list would read out of bounds natively and is rejected by the model.
Segment byte strings are the bytes the native code would copy; a null segment pointer with a nonzero length would fault natively and is rejected by the model.
The allocator is a virtual method at offset 0x18 of the owner's table and stays an oracle; whether it reads its trailing arguments is not pinned.
No return value is claimed: the known callers continue without reading rax after the call.
A negative byte span always trips the span limit (its unsigned value is at least 2**63, above the limit), so the length throw fires before any loop and a negative count never reaches the init loop.
not_claimed: The allocator's own implementation (virtual method at offset 0x18).
What the literal constant 0x4376FD points to.
The surrounding logic of the second call site's function 0x5da8870..0x5da9d99 beyond the site address.
The output record's fields past +0x08, which this function does not write.
